author: Mark Atwood
text: Verification (beads-worker-6, 2026-09-09): the premise of this bead does not hold against the committed tree. Exhaustive git grep across all tracked files (spec/, docs/, python/src, rust/, lichen/, firmware/) finds NO occurrence of '1.3.6.1.5.5.7.1.999', no 'id-pe', no '1.3.6.1.4.1' (PEN arc), and no node-role X.509 extension OID. spec/06-security.md §8.13 and §8.13.2 (the only candidate location) contain no OID arc at all — the only 'oidc:' hits are the OIDC claim-namespace table (unrelated) and '999' appears only as the emergency-services phone number. The viku.1 close reason references a cert profile with a 'role extension', but that profile text was never committed to the tree; §8.13/§8.13.2 define no role-extension OID. Therefore there is no provisional OID in the repo to replace, and nothing to edit to 'fix' this. Separately, assigning a real non-colliding OID requires an IANA Private Enterprise Number registration and arc allocation — a vendor-facing commitment that needs Mark's decision, not a worker edit. Routing to human.
